C0173.title: CV-Inspector: Towards Automating Detection of Adblock Circumvention
C0173.summary: This study develops CV-INSPECTOR, a machine learning method that automatically detects whether websites use adblock circumvention services through differential execution analysis, achieving 93% accuracy. It identifies circumvention sites among the top 20,000 websites, helping the adblock community automate and scale filter rule maintenance.
